title: Large Language Models as a Semantic Interface and Ethical Mediator in Neuro-Digital Ecosystems: Conceptual Foundations and a Regulatory Imperative
reasoning: The entire paper is a conceptual and ethical analysis of the role of LLMs in neuro-digital systems. It focuses on neuroethics and AI ethics, evaluating the impact of these technologies on mental autonomy, agency, and personhood, and proposes a framework for proactive governance based on ethical principles such as Semantic Transparency and Mental Informed Consent.
